name: playground-serial
description: Lets Playground IDE artifacts in the Claude app talk to a Dial or Box controller plugged in with USB.
long_description: Install this to use a real Smart Playground controller from the Playground IDE artifacts in the Claude desktop app. It only lists, opens, reads and writes USB serial ports on this computer. Without it, the IDE artifacts run in practice mode.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Whether a controller port is open
